quotes.author: Danielle R.
quotes.text: You get to get up close to all of the exhibits, which is super cool for kids and adults.

quotes.author: Tanner C.
quotes.text: The upper level is great, and the dinosaur and China exhibits were particular standouts.

quotes.author: Ram R.
quotes.text: The museum is full of amazing facts and provides a fantastic educational experience.

quotes.author: David
quotes.text: Whether you’re an expert or just a casual enthusiast, there’s something for everyone here.

quotes.author: Michael B.
quotes.text: Simply one of the best natural history museums anywhere.

quotes.author: JC
quotes.text: The amount of beautiful taxidermy is insane and I had the time of my life.
